_requirement_entries.description: RF front-end shall operate from 2.0 to 6.0 GHz with full coverage across S-band (2-4 GHz) and C-band (4-6 GHz).
_requirement_entries.title: Frequency Range

_requirement_entries.description: Front-end shall support 10 to 100 MHz instantaneous bandwidth per channel.
_requirement_entries.title: Instantaneous Bandwidth

_requirement_entries.description: Overall system noise figure shall be 4 to 6 dB (includes limiter, preselector, LNA chain losses).
_requirement_entries.title: System Noise Figure

_requirement_entries.description: LNA chain shall provide 40 to 60 dB of gain per channel across 2-6 GHz.
_requirement_entries.title: LNA Chain Gain

_requirement_entries.description: System input-referred third-order intercept point (IIP3) shall be +20 dBm minimum.
_requirement_entries.title: Input Linearity (IIP3)

_requirement_entries.description: Input return loss shall be 14 dB minimum (VSWR ≤ 1.5:1) across 2-6 GHz.
_requirement_entries.title: Input Return Loss

_requirement_entries.description: Front-end shall survive +30 dBm CW input power at antenna port without damage.
_requirement_entries.title: Maximum Survivable Input

_requirement_entries.description: Front-end shall tolerate +10 to +20 dBm TX leakage at LNA input during transmit mode with < 0.5 dB gain compression.
_requirement_entries.title: TX Leakage Handling

_requirement_entries.description: Input limiter shall activate at ≤ +15 dBm and provide protection up to +30 dBm with < 0.5 dB flat loss and < 10 ns recovery time.
_requirement_entries.title: Input Limiter Protection

_requirement_entries.description: LC bandpass preselector shall provide ≥ 15 dB out-of-band rejection at ±500 MHz from passband edges.
_requirement_entries.title: Preselector Filtering

_requirement_entries.description: Low-noise amplifier stages shall use GaN HEMT technology for high linearity and power handling.
_requirement_entries.title: GaN LNA Technology

_requirement_entries.description: Gain flatness shall be ±2.5 dB across 2-6 GHz per channel.
_requirement_entries.title: Gain Flatness

_requirement_entries.description: Reverse isolation shall be ≥ 40 dB to prevent LO leakage and transmitter back-reflection.
_requirement_entries.title: Reverse Isolation

_requirement_entries.description: System shall provide 4 independent parallel RF channels for monopulse ΣΔΔ beamforming with phase-matched paths.
_requirement_entries.title: 4-Channel Parallel Architecture

_requirement_entries.description: RF input/output connectors shall be 2.92mm (K) type, 50Ω, female.
_requirement_entries.title: RF Interface Connector

_requirement_entries.description: T/R switching time shall be ≤ 10 µs from transmit-to-receive and receive-to-transmit transitions.
_requirement_entries.title: T/R Switching Speed

_requirement_entries.description: LNA bias shall use active bias circuitry for temperature compensation and gate sequencing (negative gate before positive drain for GaN).
_requirement_entries.title: Active Bias Control

_requirement_entries.description: Primary supply voltage shall be +12 V DC ±10%.
_requirement_entries.title: Supply Voltage

_requirement_entries.description: Total power consumption shall be 15 to 30 W across all 4 channels including bias and control circuits.
_requirement_entries.title: Power Consumption

_requirement_entries.description: Operating temperature range shall be 0 to +70°C (commercial).
_requirement_entries.title: Operating Temperature

_requirement_entries.description: Storage temperature range shall be −40 to +85°C.
_requirement_entries.title: Storage Temperature

_requirement_entries.description: Unit shall survive MIL-STD-810 light vibration and shock profiles.
_requirement_entries.title: Vibration and Shock

_requirement_entries.description: Enclosure shall provide IP54 rating (dust-protected, water-splash resistant) for outdoor deployment.
_requirement_entries.title: Ingress Protection

_requirement_entries.description: Unit shall operate at 5% to 95% relative humidity (non-condensing).
_requirement_entries.title: Humidity

_requirement_entries.description: LNA shall use GaN HEMT technology as specified.
_requirement_entries.title: Semiconductor Technology

_requirement_entries.description: Preselector filters shall use discrete LC technology for custom 2-6 GHz tuning.
_requirement_entries.title: Filter Technology

constraints: Compatible with 70 MHz or 140 MHz first-IF
_requirement_entries.description: RF outputs shall interface to superheterodyne downconverter with 50Ω single-ended impedance.
_requirement_entries.title: Interface to Downconverter

_requirement_entries.description: LNA chain additive phase noise shall be ≤ −150 dBc/Hz at 10 kHz offset (no LO contribution).
_requirement_entries.title: Phase Noise Contribution

_requirement_entries.description: LNA chain shall be unconditionally stable with K-factor > 1.5 and B1 > 0 across 2-6 GHz.
_requirement_entries.title: Stability

_requirement_entries.description: Group delay variation shall be ≤ 5 ns across 100 MHz instantaneous bandwidth for 1-10 µs radar pulses.
_requirement_entries.title: Group Delay Variation

_requirement_entries.description: Unit shall meet applicable EMC requirements for commercial radar equipment.
_requirement_entries.title: EMC Compliance

_requirement_entries.description: All components shall be RoHS 2011/65/EU compliant.
_requirement_entries.title: RoHS Compliance

constraints: Assumes 100 MHz IBW, 5 dB NF, 10 dB SNR
_requirement_entries.description: System MDS shall be −92 dBm (derived from 5 dB NF, 100 MHz BW, 10 dB SNR).
_requirement_entries.title: Minimum Detectable Signal (MDS)

_requirement_entries.description: Mean time between failures (MTBF) shall be ≥ 50,000 hours at 40°C ambient.
_requirement_entries.title: MTBF

_requirement_entries.description: Front-end shall provide calibration access for gain/phase trimming per channel.
_requirement_entries.title: Calibration Interface

_requirement_entries.description: For GaN HEMT LNAs, negative gate voltage shall be applied before positive drain voltage; drain shall be enabled before RF signal path.
_requirement_entries.title: Bias Sequencing (GaN)

_requirement_entries.description: Junction temperature of all active devices shall remain ≤ 125°C at +70°C ambient with worst-case power dissipation.
_requirement_entries.title: Thermal Management

_requirement_entries.description: Each LNA chain shall deliver 0 to +10 dBm output power into 50Ω load at 1 dB compression.
_requirement_entries.title: Output Power Capability
